metadata.description: Display name shown in the Workbooks gallery.
Stable GUID for the workbook resource.

properties.description: Detects a significant hourly spike in total billable Sentinel ingestion using the Usage table.
properties.query:
let currentHour = Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IsBillable == true
| summarize CurrentMB = sum(Quantity);
let baseline = Usage
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(8d) .. ago(1h)) and IsBillable == true
| summarize HourlyMB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| summarize BaselineMB = avg(HourlyMB);
currentHour
| extend BaselineMB = toreal(toscalar(baseline))
| extend SpikeRatio = iif(BaselineMB == 0.0, 0.0, CurrentMB / BaselineMB)
| where CurrentMB > (BaselineMB * 2.5) and CurrentMB > 500
| project TimeGenerated = now(), CurrentMB, BaselineMB, SpikeRatio

properties.description: Detects a per-table ingestion jump in the last hour compared to 14-day hourly average.
properties.query:
let current = Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IsBillable == true
| summarize CurrentMB = sum(Quantity) by DataType;
let baseline = Usage
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1h)) and IsBillable == true
| summarize HourlyMB = sum(Quantity) by DataType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| summarize BaselineMB = avg(HourlyMB) by DataType;
current
| join kind=inner baseline on DataType
| extend SpikeRatio = iif(BaselineMB == 0.0, 0.0, CurrentMB / BaselineMB)
| where CurrentMB > (BaselineMB * 3.0) and CurrentMB > 200
| project TimeGenerated = now(), DataType, CurrentMB, BaselineMB, SpikeRatio

properties.description: Detects a significant drop in billable ingestion over the last 6 hours compared with historical baseline.
properties.query:
let recent = Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) and IsBillable == true
| summarize RecentMB = sum(Quantity);
let baseline = Usage
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(6h)) and IsBillable == true
| summarize BlockMB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 6h)
| summarize BaselineMB = avg(BlockMB);
recent
| extend BaselineMB = toreal(toscalar(baseline))
| where BaselineMB > 500 and RecentMB < (BaselineMB * 0.2)
| project TimeGenerated = now(), RecentMB, BaselineMB, DropRatio = iif(BaselineMB == 0.0, 0.0, RecentMB / BaselineMB)

properties.displayName: Usage - Velocity anomaly (last hour vs 24h average)
properties.description: Alerts when the last hour ingestion velocity (MB/hour) deviates significantly from the prior 24h average velocity.
properties.query:
let last1 = Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and IsBillable == true
| summarize Last1hMB = sum(Quantity);
let prior24 = Usage
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(25h) .. ago(1h)) and IsBillable == true
| summarize MB = sum(Quantity)
| extend Prior24hVelocityMBph = MB / 24.0
| project Prior24hVelocityMBph;
last1
| extend Prior24hVelocityMBph = toreal(toscalar(prior24))
| extend VelocityRatio = iif(Prior24hVelocityMBph == 0.0, 0.0, Last1hMB / Prior24hVelocityMBph)
| where Prior24hVelocityMBph > 100 and VelocityRatio > 2.0
| extend ProjectedExtraMBIfSustained = (Last1hMB - Prior24hVelocityMBph) * 24.0
| project TimeGenerated = now(), Last1hMB, Prior24hVelocityMBph, VelocityRatio, ProjectedExtraMBIfSustained
